reference_solution:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
t = float(data[1])
items = []
pos = 2
for _ in range(n):
    m = float(data[pos])
    v = float(data[pos + 1])
    pos += 2
    items.append((m, v))

items.sort(key=lambda item: item[1] / item[0], reverse=True)
ans = 0.0
for m, v in items:
    if t >= m:
        ans += v
        t -= m
    else:
        ans += v * (t / m)
        break

print(f"{ans:.2f}")
